text:
La Gazzetta dello Sport
Everything in reverse
Italy overwhelmed in Belgium and out of the top eight
Another Pio goal, then the Azzurro shock. They conceded three goals in 11 minutes. Mancini: ‘Lessons that will help us’
Rambo Thuram
Here’s how he changed Inter
Leader, complete striker, has better numbers than he ever has done previously and stays away from the treatment table
The Ronaldinho show is seen across the World: ‘Ravenna, I will be back’
Corriere dello Sport
Milan, 60 million for Endrick
But Mourinho blocks everything
The CEO Yormark is the twin brother of the head of the agency that represents the Madrid star | Jose says stop
Cardinale pressing to sign the Brazilian in January. The Special One opposes it: For him, the attacker is not sacrificible. Now, Perez’s club could open a bidding war for Vinicius Jr
Let’s focus on the positives
Italy third and knocked out of the Nations League: Belgium win 4-1
Mancini’s hopes of qualifying for the quarter-finals fade despite the show against France and picking up 10 points from the last five games. Esposito opens the scoring immediately (10th goal), but then KDB’s side dominate. De Cuyper, Ngoy, Doku and Moreira score. Pio misses a penalty to make it 4-2
Juve shots: Sorloth with Balde
Negotiations advancing withAtletico and Barcelona for the two signings
Ronaldinho: ‘Maybe not the last one’
Making a comeback at 46
One half on the pitch with Ravenna, was involved in the build-up for the opening goal: ‘If the President wants, I’ll come back’
Tuttosport
It was nice, believe
Italy light it up in Belgium with Pio, but then concede 4: No quarter-finals. Now we can’t afford to be discouraged
The 10th Azzurri goal for the Interista bomber counts for nothing after a defensive tilt that gifted three goals in 11 minutes to De Cuyper, Ngoy and the super Doku: Moreira grabs the fourth towards the end and Esposito missees a penalty. Mancini pays for a risky set of rotations. The physical gap was immediately obvious and there was no reaction this time. Lessons that will help us’
Spalletti: Now the real Juve
Nico and Conceicao back, Yildiz champing at the bit: The coach looks forward to the turnaround
Against Venezia on Sunday to start the comeback: The league is the absolute priority, qualification for the Champions League is fundamentally more important than the Europa League. Kenan says hi to the fans at the ATP finals during his recovery. Balogun calls Carnevali, United call McKennie
Golden Kane ends the Spanish record
England resist even with 10 men: 2-3
The World Champions’ unbeaten streak is broken after 43 games: Konsa and White also score
Toro aiming for Camarda in January
Milan will loan out the young striker
Monza (who could sell Varela) are also on the list, and Bologna as well as Samp in Serie B
Ronaldinho ole! Show in Ravenna
Playes 45 minutes, inspires them and wins: ‘Maybe I’ll be back’
At 46 years old and not just a bit-part player: ‘Playing football is still the most beautiful thing to me. If they call me back …’
digest_he: כותרות העיתונים באיטליה מתרכזות בהדחתה של הנבחרת מליגת האומות לאחר תבוסה 4-1 מול בלגיה, למרות שער מוקדם של פין אספוזיטו. המאמן מנצ'יני הודה כי הקבוצה סבלה מפער פיזי ומעיין לקחים לקראת ההמשך. במקביל, עיתוני הספורט מדווחים על פעילות מוגברת בשוק ההעברות, כאשר מילאן מקושרת לניסיונות לצרף את אנדריק, בעוד שחקן העבר רונאלדיניו בן ה-46 חזר לשחק מחצית אחת במדי ראוונה ורמז על אפשרות שישוב למגרשים.
